remediation: Use the shared Textarea owner or apply resize-none/resize: none with adequate height or auto-grow behavior.
justification: Resize restriction requires contextual accessibility assessment. Verify adequate height, zoom/reflow and no loss of entered content; do not blindly disable native resizing.
